question: In its October 2024 meeting, the RBI Monetary Policy Meeting kept the _____ unchanged at 6.5%
solution:
The correct answer is __**repo rate**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The repo rate is the rate at which the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) lends money to commercial banks in the event of any shortfall of funds.
 
• As of October 2024, the RBI kept the repo rate unchanged at 6.5% during its Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) meeting.
 
• Maintaining the repo rate can influence interest rates in the economy, impacting both inflation and economic growth.
 
• The decision to keep the repo rate unchanged is often based on current economic indicators such as inflation rates, GDP growth, and other macroeconomic factors.
 
• Repo rate adjustments are a key tool used by the RBI to maintain liquidity and control inflation in the economy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Cash Reserve Ratio (CRR)**

 
 
• CRR is the percentage of a bank's total deposits that must be maintained with the RBI in the form of reserves.
 
• It ensures that banks do not run out of cash to meet the payment demands of their depositors.
 
 
 
• **Statutory Liquidity Ratio (SLR)**
 
 
• SLR is the minimum percentage of deposits that a commercial bank has to maintain in the form of liquid cash, gold, or other securities.
 
• This is a tool used by the RBI to control the expansion of credit.
 
 
 
• **Bank Rate**
 
 
• The bank rate is the rate at which the central bank of a country lends money to domestic banks, often for long-term purposes.
 
• Changes in the bank rate can impact the overall lending rates in the economy.
 
 
 
• **Monetary Policy Committee (MPC)**
 
 
• The MPC is a committee of the RBI responsible for formulating the monetary policy of India.
 
• It consists of six members, including the RBI Governor as the chairperson.
 
• The MPC meets bi-monthly to review and decide on key policy rates, including the repo rate.
 
 
 
• **Inflation Control**
 
 
• Inflation control is one of the primary objectives of the RBI's monetary policy.
 
• By adjusting the repo rate, the RBI aims to control inflation and stabilize the economy.
